observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor studio or dance hall with mirrors and chairs along the walls, audience of observers standing and recording with phones
observation.dancers: one couple: one man and one woman
observation.formation_and_space: couple dancing in close embrace, staying in a small localized area
observation.posture: torso upright, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet in close proximity
observation.footwork: slow, subtle weight shifts and small steps matching the slow tempo, stepping close together
observation.arms_and_hands: closed partner dance hold with arms wrapped around each other's upper bodies and shoulders
observation.hips_and_torso: prominent hip rotations, rolls, and isolations driven by weight changes and close contact
observation.partnering: close contact partner dance with upper body and hip connection, led by the man
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level, no jumps, occasional slow pivot turns
observation.costume_and_props: man wears a dark t-shirt, dark jeans, cap, and sneakers; woman wears a white t-shirt, light blue jeans, and heels
observation.cannot_infer: low resolution and compressed video make exact foot placements difficult to discern in detail

signature_moments.what: slow, circular hip roll and pelvic isolation in close embrace
subtle shifting of weight with rolling hip movements synchronized to the slow beat
close-hold hip articulation and slow side-to-side weight transfer
